10th.title: Options After Class 10th
10th.description: Comprehensive pathways: Intermediate (MPC, BiPC, MEC, CEC, Arts), Polytechnic Diploma, ITI, Defence routes, Vocational training, and Apprenticeships.

streams.name: Maths, Physics, Chemistry
streams.careers: Engineering (B.Tech), NDA Defence, Architecture (B.Arch), Pure Sciences (B.Sc), Aviation

streams.name: Biology, Physics, Chemistry
streams.careers: Medicine (MBBS, BDS), AYUSH, Pharmacy, B.Sc Agriculture, Veterinary, Nursing, Biotechnology

streams.name: Maths, Economics, Commerce
streams.careers: Chartered Accountancy (CA), CMA, CS, B.Com, BBA, Actuarial Science, Data Analytics

streams.name: Commerce, Economics, Civics
streams.careers: Corporate Finance, Banking, Law (5-yr Integrated LLB), B.Com, Civil Services preparation

streams.name: History, Economics, Civics/Arts
streams.careers: Civil Services (UPSC), Journalism, Law, Public Policy, Psychology, Teaching

paths.admission: State POLYCET (e.g. AP POLYCET, TS POLYCET, JEECUP, Delhi CET)
paths.lateral_entry: Eligible for direct admission to 2nd year B.Tech via State ECET / JELET / LEET
paths.job_roles: Junior Engineer (RRB JE, SSC JE), Plant Technician (L&T, Tata Motors, BHEL), Substation Operator, DRDO/ISRO Technical Assistant

paths.admission: State Directorate of Employment & Training counselling
trades: COPA - Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (1 yr)
paths.future_options: Direct jobs as Railway ALP / Technician, PSU Apprentice, DRDO Technician A, or lateral entry into 2nd year Polytechnic Diploma

paths.eligibility: 10th Pass with 45% aggregate & 33% per subject. Age: 17.5 to 21 years.
routes: Preparation for UPSC NDA & NA exam during 11th-12th

paths.details: Govt. National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) with practical industry training in PSUs and private plants, leading to National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC).
